participants.note: ACKed, noted it reduces unwarranted nRefCount increases on onion/i2p-only nodes
pointed out a bug where newer announcements are blocked when an nTime refresh fires

claims.text: The new check runs after the nTime refresh, causing genuinely newer announcements to be blocked whenever the refresh fires.
claims.quote: the new check runs *after* the `nTime` refresh above it, which sets `pinfo->nTime = addr.nTime - time_penalty`. So whenever that refresh fires, the check becomes `addr.nTime - time_penalty <= addr.nTime - time_penalty` → always true → `return false`, blocking genuinely *newer* announcements too

support.reason: nice find; onion/i2p-only nodes will have slightly fewer addresses with inflated nRefCount

waiting_on.what: response/fix for newer announcements being blocked by the check ordering
